name: Sudan Irrigation & Agriculture Monitor
description: Network + field irrigation monitoring for Sudanese schemes: canal water, head-to-tail equity, field condition, and two-way field collection that feeds the satellite/ground reliability figure.
author: independent

map_layers.title: Head-to-tail equity
map_layers.legend: Red = flagged (95% lower bound of the gap exceeds the review threshold). Grey = not flagged. A gap is a measured difference and attributes nothing to anyone.

map_layers.title: Persistent water (for tracing canals)
map_layers.legend: Fraction of observations each pixel read as water (Sentinel-1 + MNDWI). Trace canal centrelines over the bright, continuous lines.

notes: This manifest targets the GeoLibre plugin API (opengeos/GeoLibre). The analysis engine (../src) is the original work; GeoLibre supplies the desktop/web/Android/iOS shell, offline area download, the Field Collection tool, and the Earth Engine panel.
results/*.geojson and results/water_frequency.tif are produced by the engine and geometry/build_water_frequency.py respectively; they are not checked in.
